dataset: 雾岛机构知识服务实训语料
fiction_disclosure: 本文件为虚构馆务与机构资料；运行时只把document.text作为资料交给阿灯，说明留在教材。

documents.title: 分馆A临时开馆安排
documents.text: [KB-A-01] Branch A opens this Saturday at 14:00 and closes at 18:00. Morning shelf maintenance delays opening. This document does not specify Sunday reading-room hours.

documents.title: 分馆A周日还书箱
documents.text: [KB-A-02] The self-service return box is outside the east gate. It is available when the reading room is closed on Sunday. Return-box access does not imply the reading room is open.

documents.title: 分馆A志愿者报名
documents.text: [KB-A-03] Volunteer registration is at the reception desk on Saturday from 14:00 to 16:00. Bring the required form. Registration hours are shorter than library opening hours.

documents.title: 分馆A雨天入口
documents.text: [KB-A-04] On rainy days visitors use the east covered entrance. Rain does not automatically close the library. Temporary closure needs a separately confirmed notice.

documents.title: 分馆A旧索引提示
documents.text: [KB-A-05] A search index stores a document version and a content hash. Updating a source requires invalidating stale chunks and cached answers that depend on it.

documents.title: 分馆A发布审核
documents.text: [KB-A-06] Lin He confirms the exact notice version before publication. Approval for an earlier version does not authorize a modified notice. A publication receipt identifies the version actually posted.

documents.title: 分馆A任务交班
documents.text: [KB-A-07] A consultation thread retains its task identity, input fingerprint and pending position. A new process must check these before resuming. Checkpoint storage alone does not make external writes idempotent.

documents.title: 分馆A答复偏好
documents.text: [KB-A-08] Confirmed preferences belong to the named anonymous reader. The latest version controls consent, withdrawal and expiration. A withdrawn latest version must not revive an older preference.

documents.title: 分馆A查询范围
documents.text: [KB-A-09] Retrieval filters documents by the trusted branch identity before placing excerpts in model input. A visitor cannot change branch scope by putting a different tenant name in the question.

documents.title: 分馆A超时核对
documents.text: [KB-A-10] Client timeout means the result did not arrive in time. It does not prove the service did not commit. Read the operation ledger and use the same input-bound idempotency key when retrying.

documents.title: 分馆A报告交付
documents.text: [KB-A-11] A research report separates supported conclusions, recommendations and unresolved gaps. A failed child investigation remains a failed or partial result, not a normal successful completion.

documents.title: 分馆A维修验收
documents.text: [KB-A-12] A passing fixed test must match the current candidate file hash. Protected tests cannot be edited to manufacture success. Generated candidate code runs only in the isolated maintenance workspace.

documents.title: 分馆B开放安排
documents.text: [KB-B-01] Branch B opens on Saturday at 09:00 and closes at 12:00. These hours are private to Branch B operations and are not Branch A's current schedule.

documents.title: 分馆B私有报名说明
documents.text: [KB-B-02] Branch B volunteer registration closes at 10:00. Access requires Branch B scope. Similar wording in another branch document does not grant access.

documents.title: 分馆B内部交班
documents.text: [KB-B-03] Branch B's internal handover notes belong to this branch namespace. Shared search infrastructure must not share private snippets with Branch A users.

documents.title: 分馆B方法权限
documents.text: [KB-B-04] A method guide describes how to verify notices. It does not grant permission to publish, remove preferences or run arbitrary commands.
